paper.title_en: Stochastic gravitational-wave background from self-interacting superradiant clouds
paper.abstract_en: Gravitational-wave (GW) observations offer a powerful probe of new fundamental fields. One well-motivated source is black hole (BH)--boson cloud systems, in which an ultralight scalar field forms a cloud around a rotating BH via superradiance and emits long-lived nearly monochromatic GWs. In this work, we compute the stochastic GW background (SGWB) from such systems, extending previous work by including scalar self-interactions, and discuss its detectability with next-generation ground-based GW detectors. We find that self-interactions can suppress the SGWB and thereby relax existing LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA constraints inferred from null searches. Namely, the LIGO detectors at design sensitivity are insensitive to a SGWB produced by scalar fields with a decay constant $f_\mathrm{s} \lesssim 3\times 10^{17}$ GeV, independently of the scalar field mass. Looking ahead, we show that a moderately self-interacting cloud can still produce a detectable SGWB with next-generation detectors. Under conservative assumptions, for a decay constant $f_\mathrm{s} = 10^{17}$ GeV, the Einstein Telescope (ET) will be sensitive to scalar masses in the range $\sim[10^{-13.0},10^{-11.8}]$ eV, while Cosmic Explorer (CE) will be sensitive to scalar masses in the range $\sim[10^{-13.2},10^{-11.7}]$ eV. We also find that the minimum decay constants that still yield a detectable SGWB for ET and CE are $f_\mathrm{s}\sim 6\times10^{16}\,$GeV and $\sim 3\times10^{16}\,$GeV, respectively.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文计算了包含标量自相互作用的黑洞-玻色子云系统产生的随机引力波背景，并给出了下一代地面引力波探测器的探测灵敏度预测，属于脉冲星计时阵列及引力波背景相关核心主题，理论推导与数值估算具有相当深度，且对现有LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA限制的放松给出了明确结论。
decision.title_zh: 自相互作用超辐射云产生的随机引力波背景
decision.abstract_zh: 引力波（GW）观测为探测新的基本场提供了强有力的手段。一个动机充分的源是黑洞（BH）-玻色子云系统，其中超轻标量场通过超辐射在旋转黑洞周围形成云，并发出长寿命、近乎单色的引力波。在本工作中，我们计算了此类系统产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB），通过纳入标量自相互作用扩展了先前的工作，并讨论了利用下一代地面引力波探测器对其进行探测的可能性。我们发现，自相互作用可以抑制SGWB，从而放松现有由零结果搜索推断出的LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA限制。也就是说，设计灵敏度的LIGO探测器对衰减常数$f_\mathrm{s} \lesssim 3\times 10^{17}$ GeV的标量场产生的SGWB不敏感，且与标量场质量无关。展望未来，我们表明，一个中等自相互作用的云仍能产生下一代探测器可探测的SGWB。在保守假设下，对于衰减常数$f_\mathrm{s} = 10^{17}$ GeV，爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）将对标量质量范围$\sim[10^{-13.0},10^{-11.8}]$ eV敏感，而宇宙探索者（CE）将对标量质量范围$\sim[10^{-13.2},10^{-11.7}]$ eV敏感。我们还发现，对于ET和CE，仍能产生可探测SGWB的最小衰减常数分别为$f_\mathrm{s}\sim 6\times10^{16}\,$GeV和$\sim 3\times10^{16}\,$GeV。
